value.description: Find all webhook URL usage paths

value.text:
Webhook paths are one source of outbound requests. User-configured URLs are stored via CreateUserWebhook and UpdateUserWebhook. They are dispatched through memo operations to webhook.PostAsync. That method calls webhook.Post. Finally safeClient.Do(req) executes the HTTP request.

Link metadata paths are another source. GetLinkMetadata and BatchGetLinkMetadata fetch user-provided URLs via httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta. Whether these count as user-configured URLs is unclear. I will examine memo_service_link_metadata.go and related documentation to clarify.

CreateMemo directly triggers the memo-created webhook. CreateMemoComment also triggers the memo-created webhook because it invokes CreateMemo internally.

UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations also dispatch webhooks. All paths converge at `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`, reached through `webhook.PostAsync`.

`webhook.PostAsync` is the convergence point before delivery. All dispatch paths enqueue to the async queue there. `webhook.Post` is the single function that performs the actual HTTP request.

CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, and DeleteMemo each trigger a direct webhook dispatch. CreateMemoComment transitively causes webhooks through both memo creation and comment creation side effects.

SetMemoAttachments and SetMemoRelations also trigger memo update webhooks through dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects.

All paths converge in `webhook.PostAsync` in `memo_service_webhooks.go`. That function enqueues requests before they reach `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`, where `safeClient.Do(req)` performs the actual HTTP delivery.
